profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
I received my Bachelor of Computer Science at Oregon State University with a focus on Artificial Intelligence. I discovered my passion for programming when I joined my high school's robotics team, and since then I have continued to love solving the puzzle of coding. I am passionate about solving problems and I find joy in creating responsive, user friendly, detail-oriented designs.

In my free time I enjoy producing music, 3D modeling, and game development.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Restructured front end code base for four products, used by over 90 municipalities
- Designed and implemented new features using CSS, JS, and Java
- Created and maintained graphic elements
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Graphic Design · Web Design · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Code Refactoring

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Redesigned most main pages and increased mobile support
- Provided continued development support and design consultation
positions.insights: Skills: Graphic Design · Web Design · Drupal · SEO Copywriting · Mobile Web Design

positions.title: Test Technician
positions.description:
- Tested client’s products and logged defects using Jira, CLI tools, and a wide array of devices and routers
- Adapted quickly to new testing environments and teams
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Quality Assurance · Technical Documentation · Mobile Devices · Router Configuration

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description: Through recommendation from Sonya Itchkavich-Levasseur, a member of the web development team,  I was able to return again for the web dev internship position.

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Resolved over 30 customer created and internally reported issues
• Worked with marketing and design teams to create landing pages
• Helped maintain their numerous sites and blogs using PHP, JS, Wordpress, and SCSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the OSU student-founded company ShoeBio
• Prototyped a web scraping backend from scratch, scraping over 100 online vendors for shoe pricing data using Python and AWS

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Created a dynamic website from the ground up using AWS, Python, and the Google Maps API which let users create bike routes, vote for potential connection points, and submit feedback
• Part of the University of Oregon's FastTraq project, which aims to let bikers press crosswalk buttons virtually through an app that connects to Eugene's traffic grid
